# Teacher answers — Addressing and subnetting
Original draft 14 October 2026. Four week 12 lessons, no added project or weighting. Review/audit remain pending.
70/27: mask 255.255.255.224, network 192.168.50.64, broadcast .95, ordinary hosts .65–.94,32 total/30 usable. AND final octet 01000110 with 11100000 yields 01000000 (64). First 24+3 network bits;5 host bits. /20 transfer: mask 255.255.240.0, network 10.1.16.0, broadcast 10.1.31.255, hosts 10.1.16.1–10.1.31.254, 4096 total/4094 usable.
From.70/27,.94 is local prefix and.100 is remote; gateway .65 valid plan candidate, .1 outside,.64 network,.95 broadcast,.70 duplicate own address. Mathematical validity is not proof of router reachability. Check masks/links/routes and separate DNS from addressing.
Equal /26 blocks in the /24 start 0,64,128,192;64 total/62 usable each. Variable plan Media .0/26(51 need/62 usable), Staff .64/27(26/30), Devices .96/28(13/14), Visitors .112/28(7/14); gateway first host 1,65,97,113. Remaining .128/25 reserved. Parent containment and no overlap are essential. Visitors /29 lacks room for gateway . Staff .32/27 intersects Media .0/26.
RFC 1918 exactly 10/8,172.16/12,192.168/16;172.15 and 172.32 outside. Outside these blocks does not imply public reachability; loopback/link-local/documentation are special. is_rfc1918 helper is explicit membership, not Python is_private shorthand. Private addresses can be routed internally; external access mechanisms/security are separate.
IPv6 expands 2001:db8:50:1::70 to 2001:0db8:0050:0001:0000:0000:0000:0070.128 bits, eight 16-bit groups; prefix first four groups at /64. Network 2001:db8:50:2::/64 differs. :: once; remove leading zeros and compress longest run with leftmost tie preference. No broadcast or blanket subtract-two formula; /31 IPv4 point-to-point and /32 host routes also need their own conventions. 2001:db8::/32 is documentation space. Larger address space is not automatic encryption.
The calculator returns ordinary LAN ranges for IPv4 /0–/30, capacity choices, prefix membership and gateway candidate checks. It does not assign hosts, route traffic, implement /31 links or allocate IPv6. Preserve manual reasoning before tool verification.
